text:
maya_prod: Ping — quick design check: new Usage row mock in Figma (https://www.figma.com/file/ghi/usage-rail-v3). Main tradeoffs: tiny stacked bars inline vs small donut in a flyout. Also export placement for invoices: header primary vs per-row quick-preview. Thoughts?
kai_design: Inline tiny bars keep density and match sparklines. Donut is clearer for single-project breakdown but becomes unreadable with many token types. Suggest default to bars, donut in flyout.
neel_fe: Agree. Bars = simple divs, virtualize well. Donut requires canvas + hit test; heavy for long lists. Also recommend a global units toggle (tokens / k / M) to avoid layout shift.
ava_a11y: A11y: always render textual list before visuals for SRs. Donut must have aria-labels like "Billable tokens: 12.3k (34%)". Legend keyboard-focusable; avoid color-only cues.
sam_pm: Decision lean: header-level "Export invoice (PDF)" as primary (contextual to scope) + per-row quick-preview (one-line) only. Full exports via header to avoid accidental heavy jobs. Debounce exports server-side and show toast with link.
rio_research: In tests people liked one-line invoice previews inline. It cut clicks. I'll add metrics for preview clicks vs export clicks.
maya_prod: Action items: Kai upload bar + donut flyout mocks by Wed, Neel spike fixed-width totals + units toggle, Ava draft a11y checklist, Rio add metrics, Sam confirm filename pattern with legal. Deploy-bot: staging flag "usage-ui-v3" enabled for 2025-06-03 deploy.
deploy-bot: Note: staging deploy 2025-06-03 02:00 UTC — wrap behind feature flag.
kai_design: will annotate print-friendly patterns and legend interactivity hint ("Click to filter").
neel_fe: will respect prefers-reduced-motion and throttle live updates to 1s.
maya_prod: thanks all — aiming for a short dev spike next sprint :rocket:
